title: JSON Schema Lighthouse: validation journey & quickstart visuals
creator: Leah Ortiz
description: Design a concise, developer-focused quickstart visual playbook for JSON Schema / structured output that can be shipped with the console-2025.03 release. Deliverables include a set of annotated screenshots for the Console quickstart, a compact validation panel component (states: success, warnings, errors, auto-correct suggestions), microcopy for inline hints, an accessibility checklist, and a short Figma prototype demonstrating the validation journey with error recovery and suggested fixes.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity quickstart screenshots (desktop and narrow tablet) exported and annotated for docs
Interactive Figma prototype demonstrating: paste prompt -> schema attach -> live validation -> fix suggestion -> success state
Validation panel designs covering: no-schema, schema-valid, schema-warnings, schema-errors, schema-auto-correct-preview
Microcopy and developer-friendly examples included in doc-ready format (4 examples: simple object, nested arrays, enums, function-calling response)
Accessibility checklist: color contrast, keyboard focus, screen-reader labels
Linked design assets and a PR-ready markdown snippet for Console release notes
updates: 2025-02-26: Kickoff with PM and eng to align on scope. Agreed deliverables and examples set (object, nested arrays, enums, function-calling).

2025-03-02: Hi-fi mockups complete for success and error states. Engineering flagged a need for an 'auto-correct preview' state to show suggested JSON fixes — added to acceptance criteria.
2025-03-03: Accessibility review pass 1. Updated color palette for contrast and added explicit aria-label suggestions to microcopy.
2025-03-04: Preparing export package for engineering and docs. Raised a small follow-up: confirm translation/localization scope with GTM before finalizing microcopy.
